Zero lock-in

It lives inside your app — not beside it.

Your login, your registration, your User model. LaraSaaS reads them from config and minds its own business.

No LaraSaaS\User — the kit resolves whatever model you point it to.

Your guard, your middleware stack, your route names.

Bill the user… or a workspace. One config key apart.

Broadcasts, scheduled and polite.

Colored typings, start/end windows, CTAs and per-user dismissals — straight from the demo Postgres table. Broadcast one right now; it persists until you dismiss it.

Module 03 — Feature flags

Rollouts with surgical precision.

Laravel Pennant flags, declared in config and evaluated per scope. Flip the toggles to see targeted widgets react — a preview of Feature::for($workspace).

Ship today

Zero to SaaS in four commands.

01Require
step 01
$ composer require larasaas/larasaas

Works with any Laravel 10/11/12 app — Breeze React recommended.

02Install
step 02
$ php artisan larasaas:install --migrate

Publishes config, migrations, translations and the React components.

03Stripe keys
step 03
$ STRIPE_KEY=pk_test_… STRIPE_SECRET=sk_test_…
$ STRIPE_PRICE_GROWTH_MONTHLY=price_…

Point STRIPE_PRICE_* env vars at your Stripe catalogue.

04Ship it
step 04
$ php artisan serve
$ # → http://localhost:8000/app/pricing

That's it. /app/pricing is live. Start selling.
